what_it_does: FZModules is a framework for building custom data compression pipelines that can run on CPUs, GPUs, or both in combination. Scientific experiments generate massive amounts of data that must be compressed to fit in storage and to transfer over networks. The framework lets researchers assemble and modify compression stages (individual processing steps) quickly, rather than being locked into pre-built GPU compression programs. The system automatically handles memory movement and task scheduling across heterogeneous hardware.
